annotation-grey.purpose: Meta labels. May sit on Paper (4.84:1), NEVER on Vellum (4.33:1, fails AA).

vellum.purpose: THE page ground (public and /admin <main>). Also chip and input fills. --misa-muted on Vellum FAILS AA (4.33:1).

paper.purpose: Cards, sheets, control-bearing sections. No longer the page.

plate-edge.purpose: Opaque twin of Frame: rgba(29,31,32,0.2) resolved over Vellum Shade. Frames on an UNKNOWN ground (floating plates, .sheet).

hero-headline.purpose:
Home hero only. Dips at lg because the split's type column is narrowest there. No text-balance (explicit
).

page-hero-headline.purpose: PageHero on interior pages. Centred, text-balance, max 18ch.

eyebrow.purpose: Budgeted per page; the five phase-2 pages use zero.

button.transform: uppercase (applied by button.tsx; labels are sentence case in the DOM)

officer-page-title.purpose: /admin only. Every admin screen opens with one.

officer-sub.purpose: /admin only; renders an <h3>. The one step the public ramp lacks.

identifier.purpose: An EID, /admin only — separates l from 1.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A resting element above the page: a card, a floating image plate, .sheet.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: The same element under the pointer. The ONLY hover elevation. Currently unused.

shadows.name: sticky
shadows.purpose: A bar pinned over scrolling content (header-lift).

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Transform easing for every scroll-reveal entrance. The house curve; opacity runs on plain ease alongside it.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: emil-design-eng entering/exiting curve. Additive, and deliberately NOT named --ease-out, which is one of Tailwind's own theme keys.

motion.name: ease-in-out-quint
motion.purpose: emil-design-eng moving/morphing curve. There is no ease-IN curve in the system on purpose.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Active feedback on a control. The press is an ink change, never a transform.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Every hover in the system is a colour swap on this duration.

motion.name: duration-overlay
motion.purpose: Disclosure panels and expanding filter groups.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: A section's LEAD element. At most one per section: this is the authored moment.

motion.name: reveal-up
motion.purpose: Ordinary blocks following a lead. Short travel, gets out of the way.

motion.name: reveal-lateral
motion.purpose: The alternating two-column rows, entering from their own side. md-and-up ONLY: at 390px a 24px offset against the 20px gutter pushed the document 4px past the viewport.

motion.name: reveal-fade
motion.purpose: Dense content: tables, standings, card grids. A row that slides is a row the reader has to wait for.

motion.name: reveal-wipe
motion.purpose: Hairline rules and plates, drawn on rather than moved in.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Delay increment between siblings in a revealed group, set via --reveal-delay.

motion.name: marquee-left
motion.purpose: Upper home-page gallery track. Translates by exactly one group width in pixels (--marquee-shift), never a percentage.

motion.name: marquee-right
motion.purpose: Lower home-page gallery track, opposed direction from the same keyframe block.

grounds.name: white
grounds.use: Sections carrying controls or tabular data (a correctness control: five primitives fill with Vellum).

grounds.name: panel
grounds.use: The same grey, declared on the section itself.

grounds.name: field
grounds.use: Heroes, feature bands. Measure contrast at both ends.

radii.name: structure
radii.purpose: Sections, tables, inputs, buttons, panels, chips, any 1px-seam cell.

radii.name: plate
radii.purpose: Only a thing that floats: image plates and raised sheets. Needs overflow:hidden.

narrative.northStar: A navy-and-white institutional drawing set, now with depth
narrative.overview:
A navy-and-white institutional drawing set, now with depth — a drawn navy field, a flat grey page, and white surfaces lifted off it. Square structure, softened plates, hairline rules.

v1 was flat by inheritance — white behind everything, 1px borders, no shadows. v2 has a drawn navy field, a flat grey page, and white surfaces lifted off it. Depth comes from real stacked planes, never from a drawn texture pretending to be space.
keyCharacteristics: The page is a ground, and things sit on it.
Structure is square; objects are softened.
One varying property reads as a set; four read as scatter.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule is RETIRED
rules.body: v2 has five grounds, a closed set: page, white, panel, navy, field. Adding a sixth is a change to DESIGN.md, not a prop.

rules.name: The Rare Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy is the colour of everything that is merely true. A second accent, or a tint of navy outside the Pressed↔Drafting ramp, is still refused.

rules.name: No raw framework colour scales
rules.body: red-700, amber-600, green-800 are banned; reach for a named status token.

rules.name: Muted on Paper, never on Vellum
rules.body: --misa-muted (#6f7275) is 4.84:1 on white and 4.33:1 on the grey page ground, which FAILS AA. Any commit that changes a ground re-measures every grey sitting on it.

rules.name: ground="white" is a correctness control
rules.body: Five primitives fill with Vellum (controlClass, the sticky THead, FilterChip, Banner neutral, Tr hover). On the page ground they vanish; give the section a white ground, never recolour the primitive. Wrap in white first, flip the ground last.

rules.name: Shadows are tinted, never black
rules.body: All four elevation steps are navy at low alpha; rgba(0,0,0,…) is a bug. A shadow tinted to the ground composites to nothing on that ground.

rules.name: Four elevation steps, each with a job
rules.body: lift, raised, overlay, sticky. A fifth step is a change to DESIGN.md.

rules.name: The Shape Consistency Lock
rules.body: Only a thing that floats is rounded (4px plate). Structure is square. 1px is the only border weight.

rules.name: A radius needs a clip
rules.body: .plate carries overflow:hidden because the hatch squares the corners back off without it.

rules.name: Headings are ground-aware via a variant, not a prop
rules.body: Headline carries [.on-navy_&]:text-white; a dark prop would be a second source of truth.

rules.name: Monospace means an identifier
rules.body: Only in /admin, for EIDs transcribed by hand.

rules.name: Space between sections belongs to the sections
rules.body: <Section> owns ground + gutter + rhythm together; never a margin between sections.

rules.name: A seam is built from two paddings
rules.body: One from each neighbour; 32 + 32 = 64px at desktop. Where a neighbour cannot contribute, the one side brings the whole 64px.

rules.name: A shared-rule plate is one background through gap:1px
rules.body: Never a border per cell; cells stay opaque.

rules.name: The layout-family budget
rules.body: A family appears at most once per page; eight sections need at least four families; no more than two consecutive image+text splits. Declare the family in a comment per section.

rules.name: The nav cannot grow without measuring
rules.body: Re-measured 2026-09-18 at 1280: 342px left, 450px right. The left is the tighter side; on a phone, the MEMBER PORTAL button beside the centred wordmark.

rules.name: One varying property reads as a set
rules.body: The hero's three plates share one aspect ratio, frame and radius, and vary only in position and a mirrored angle.

rules.name: Colour swaps are the only hover
rules.body: No hover on any plate or card, because none is interactive. No pause-on-hover on the marquee.

rules.name: No ease-in curve
rules.body: An ease-in start reads as lag on anything a person is waiting for. UI response stays under 300ms.

rules.name: Revealed state is clip-path:none
rules.body: inset(0 0 0 0) clips descendants and sliced the tilted plates; wipe keeps its own inset() rule.

rules.name: A primitive with no call sites has not ended the drift
rules.body: Extracting the component is half the job; the adoption is the other half.

rules.name: Button labels are sentence case in the DOM
rules.body: button.tsx applies uppercase; the caps live in one place.

dos: Reach for `<Section>` for every band. Ground, gutter and rhythm move together.
Give a new ground its focus-ring answer in the same commit.
Declare the layout family in a comment at the top of each section.
Put the rotation on `.plate` and the reveal on the wrapper.
Use `ground="white"` for any section carrying inputs, chips or a table.
Write the arithmetic down when a composition depends on it.
donts: Don't use `paper` / `.ground-paper` / `.paper-grid`. All three are deleted.
Don't put a `border` and `overflow: hidden` and a `transform` on one element and then blame the border when the frame disappears.
Don't recolour a shared primitive to fix one page's ground. Give the **section** a ground instead — the primitives are shared with `/admin`.
Don't reach for a raw framework colour scale.
Don't add a hover affordance to something that is not interactive.
Don't add a fifth elevation step, a sixth ground, or a third radius without changing this file.
Don't put an aspect-ratio-sized tile in the marquee; its geometry is derived from pixel widths.
Don't animate `box-shadow`. Animate the opacity of a pseudo-element.
Don't add a `loading.tsx` **and** granular `<Suspense>` to one route.
Don't ship photography to git without the officer.
